outcome: surgical wound infection after abdominal hysterectomy
cohort: 400 women undergoing abdominal hysterectomy, with and without cancer, participating in hospitals of Tabriz University of Medical Sciences.
finding: The incidence of ulcers after hysterectomy was between 6% and 7%, with factors such as the use of immune-suppressing drugs, diabetes, late shaving before surgery, and the urgency of surgery leading to an increased risk of infection.
